## Plan / implementation

- `crates/hh-eval/src/faults.rs` — `FaultType` gains the seven
  spec-named HAL variants (`HalTimeout`→`timeout`,
  `HalErrorResponse`→`error_response`,
  `HalPartialFailure`→`partial_failure`, `HalRateLimit`→`rate_limit`,
  `HalNetworkError`→`network_error`,
  `HalInvalidResponse`→`invalid_response`,
  `HalEmptyResponse`→`empty_response`); `stage3_fault_profiles()`
  gains the `f/hal-*-pNN` catalogue entries bound at
  `at: "provider_call"` (ADR-0348 D4).
- `crates/hh-budget/src/matchspec.rs` — `validate_match` delegates to
  `validate_match_at(arms, Granularity)` (re-exported at the crate
  root): `ProductLevel` admits `search_budget = unknown` — the
  cap/metering cross-checks skip the unknown-search arm (never a
  zero coercion — T-LCD-07) while the enforcement checks still bind
  it; `ConfigurationLevel` refuses it `UnbudgetedArm`; M3
  `matched_total` refuses it at any granularity (D1).
- `crates/hh-eval/src/compare.rs` — `CompareInput.granularity`
  (default `ConfigurationLevel`); the report records
  `search_unknown` when any arm's search budget is unknown.
- `crates/hh-lab/src/analysis.rs` — `BudgetMatch.search_unknown`
  serialized only when `true`, decoded defaulting `false` (old
  reports decode unchanged).
- `crates/hh-lab/src/experiment.rs` — `check_arms` admits an absent
  `search_budget` only on an arm assigning a `hosted`-class level
  (`UnbudgetedArm` otherwise); `check_match` picks each comparand
  group's granularity by the same predicate and runs
  `validate_match_at`; new refusal variant
  `BudgetMismatchWithinArm`.
- `crates/hh-lab/src/expand.rs` — `ArmConfiguration.budget_ref`
  (additive); `expand` refuses `BudgetMismatchWithinArm` when the
  sealed configuration's budget binding differs from the arm's
  `eval_budget` (D2; CF-099).
- `crates/hh-eval/src/judge.rs` — `judge_context_for(run,
  independence)` derives the `JudgeContext` from an `EvalRun` + its
  declared `IndependenceVector` (unbound judge →
  `JudgeError::UnboundJudge`); `recheck_judged` is the consume-side
  re-admission; the calibration-expiry fold is the deterministic
  rule replayed over run facts (D3; ADR-0047(c)).
- `crates/hh-embed/src/eval_ops.rs` — `decode_arms` promotes
  `native: false` arms to hosted `BudgetEnforcement` with
  `search_budget: None`; `compare_input` decodes `granularity`
  (default `configuration_level`). Free-form `json` params — no
  schema regeneration (CC7 clean).
- `crates/hh-embed/src/experiment_ops.rs` — `arm_configs` decodes
  the additive `budget_ref`.
- `crates/hh-analysis/src/kernel.rs` — `compare_input` computes the
  pair's granularity.
- `crates/hh-experiment/src/errors.rs` — `refusal_code` maps the
  new variant.
- `crates/hh-bundle/tests/s4_2.rs` — OQ-377 interim-rule pin:
  `foreign_import_mints_no_experiment_binding` asserts the lifted
  manifest's `subject.experiment` map is empty, the import record
  names no experiment, and the provenance stays
  `unverified`/`import` (the two marks the leaderboard's L6 gate
  reads as `undisclosed`; D5).
- Batteries: `hh-eval/tests/r2_16.rs` (14), `hh-bench/tests/
  r2_16.rs` (4 over the recorded corpus), `hh-lab/tests/r2_16.rs` (2).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0348` — the five owned rulings.
